type1_coverage.question: Does the Welch test hold its 5% error rate and 95% coverage, even on heavy-tailed revenue?
type1_coverage.headline: Welch false-positive rate 3.9%-5.1% and 95% CI coverage 94.4%-95.9% across metrics and sizes.

peeking.question: How does naive peeking compare with a working-normal mSPRT approximation?
peeking.headline: Peeking 100 times inflates false positives to 38.1%; working-normal mSPRT has 1.6% empirically (not a formal guarantee).

cuped.question: Does CUPED reduce variance as much as theory says, without inflating false positives?
cuped.headline: At rho=0.7 CUPED shrinks the SE to 0.73x (theory 0.71x) and lifts power from 50% to 79% with false-positive rate 5.3%.

ratio_metrics.question: What happens if a ratio metric is analysed per event instead of per user?
ratio_metrics.headline: At ICC=0.10, per-session analysis has a 14.5% false-positive rate; the delta method has 5.1%.

srm.question: How sensitive is the SRM check, and how often does it false-alarm?
srm.headline: SRM check false-alarm rate 0.10% at threshold 0.001; detects a 50.5/49.5 split at n=100k 45% of the time.

multiple_testing.question: How often does a many-metric readout produce a false win?
multiple_testing.headline: With 14 null metrics, P(at least one false win) is 52% uncorrected, 5.7% with Holm, 5.8% with Benjamini-Hochberg.
